name: no-permissions
on: workflow_dispatch
jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: docker://alpine:3.20

name: oidc
on: workflow_dispatch
jobs:
  deploy:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      id-token: write
      contents: read
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683

name: pinned
on: workflow_dispatch
permissions:
  contents: read
jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683
      - run: echo ok

name: pwn-request
on:
  pull_request_target:
    types: [labeled]
permissions: write-all
jobs:
  build:
    if: github.event.label.name == 'never-applied'
    runs-on: [self-hosted, linux]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
      - run: echo "${{ github.event.pull_request.title }}"

name: deploy
on: workflow_dispatch
permissions:
  contents: read
  deployments: write
jobs:
  deploy:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    environment: prod-eu
    steps:
      - run: echo deployed

name: ci
on: [push, pull_request]
permissions:
  contents: read
jobs:
  ci:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - run: echo ok

name: lint
on: [push, pull_request]
permissions:
  contents: read
jobs:
  lint:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - run: exit 1

name: approve
on: pull_request
permissions:
  pull-requests: write
jobs:
  approve:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - run: gh pr review --approve "$PR" --repo "$REPO"
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          PR: ${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
          REPO: ${{ github.repository }}

name: ci
on: [push, pull_request]
permissions:
  contents: read
jobs:
  ci:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - run: echo ok

name: release
on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      attest:
        type: boolean
        default: true
permissions:
  contents: write
  id-token: write
  attestations: write
jobs:
  release:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - run: echo "fetcher test artifact ${{ github.run_id }}" > artifact.txt
      - if: inputs.attest
        uses: actions/attest-build-provenance@v2
        with:
          subject-path: artifact.txt
      - run: |
          tag="v0.1.${{ github.run_number }}"
          gh release create "$tag" artifact.txt --draft --title "$tag" --notes "Paramify fetcher test fixture."             --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --target "$GITHUB_SHA"
          gh release edit "$tag" --draft=false --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY"
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
